column1: # Resident Evil 0, Switch 1.0.0 profile; verified MT Framework render limiter and shared movie pacing.
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
# Native MT Framework limiter is raised through sMain::mpInstance + 0x4c only;
# +0x48 remains the original simulation-time scale. Default to adaptive 120 mode:
# 120 Hz displays can reach 120 fps; 60 Hz displays and movies fall back safely.
# The writable MT Framework limiter is supported on iOS; expose 120 on ProMotion iPads.
